Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:11:1.hebrew: א"ל איזיל ואייתי זוזי - ואשלם לך, ומעתה אל תאכל פירות עוד:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:11:1.english: [If] he said to him: "I will go and bring [the] money" - and I will pay you, and from now on do not consume produce anymore.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:11:2.hebrew: לא אכיל - הואיל והמעות מוכנים לו, ולא נתנו לו רשות להיות שומט ואוכל, ובאתרא דמסלקי קאי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:11:2.english: [He] may not consume - Since the money is ready for him, and they did not give him permission to continue taking and eating [the produce], and [this refers to] a place where they evict [the lender].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:13:1.hebrew: שדה אחוזה - שאמרה תורה (ויקרא כז) לפדותה מן ההקדש לפי השנים שעד היובל, סלע ופונדיון לשנה, כפי חשבון חמשים שקל לבית זרע חומר שעורים לארבעים ותשע שנות היובל:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:13:1.english: An ancestral field - For the Torah stated (Leviticus 27) to redeem it from the Temple treasury according to the years [remaining] until the Jubilee — a sela and a pundion per year, according to the calculation of fifty shekels for an area [sufficient] for sowing a chomer of barley for the forty-nine years of the Jubilee.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:13:2.hebrew: ואע"ג דאכיל פירי - הקדש טובא, ששוין פירות של כל השנה הרבה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:13:2.english: And even though he consumes produce - [of] consecrated [property] abundantly, as the produce of the entire year is worth a great deal.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:1:1.hebrew: כגדולים - ואע"ג דאכל שיעור זוזי, לא מסלקינן ליה, דקסבר מתחילת אכילתן אבק רבית הוא, ואין כח בדיינין להוציאו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:1:1.english: As adults - And even though he consumed [produce to] the value of the coins, we do not remove him [from the land], for [Rav Ashi] holds [that] from the start of eating them, it is indirect interest [avak ribbit], and the judges have no power to exact it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:2:1.hebrew: באתרא דמסלקי לא ניכול פירא אלא בנכייתא - שינכה לו מן החוב דבר קצוב לשנה, דנראה כמוכרו לו ויורד בספק, דאפילו תלקה ולא יהו בה פירות, ינכה לו אותה קצבה. הלכך, כי שקיל מיניה טפי, לאו רבית הוא. ודווקא באתרא דמסלקי, אבל באתרא דלא מסלקי כל ימי הזמן, הוי כמכירה אצלו, ובלא נכייתא נמי אכול:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:2:1.english: In a place where they remove [the lender], he may not consume produce except with a deduction - That he deducts for him from the debt a fixed amount per year, so that it looks like he is selling [the field] to him and [the lender] enters into a risk — for even if [the field] is blighted and has no produce, he will deduct that fixed amount for him. Therefore, when he takes more from it, it is not interest. And [this applies] specifically in a place where they remove [the lender]; but in a place where they do not remove [him] during the entire period [of the loan], it is like a sale to him, and even without a deduction he may also consume [the produce].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:2:2.hebrew: וצורבא מדרבנן - שצריך לישר דרכיו ולהתקדש אף במותר לו, פן ילמדו ממנו לזלזל באיסורין, אפילו בנכייתא נמי לא ניכול:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:2:2.english: And a Torah scholar - Since he must straighten his ways and sanctify himself even in what is permitted to him, lest [people] learn from him to treat prohibitions lightly, even with a deduction he may not consume [the produce].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:5:1.hebrew: מאן דאסר בקמייתא - ללישנא קמא דאמר באוכל בלא נכייתא פליגי, סבר בבתרייתא כולי עלמא שרי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:5:1.english: The one who prohibits in the first [version] - According to the first version, which says they disagree regarding one who consumes [the produce] without deduction, he holds [that] in the second [version] everyone permits [it].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:5:2.hebrew: למאן דאסר בבתרייתא - ללישנא בתרא דאמרינן, אפילו כי אכל חמש שנים קמאי בנכייתא פליגי, דחד מנייהו אסר — היכא שרי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:5:2.english: For the one who prohibits in the latter [version] - According to the latter version, [in which] we say [that] even when he consumes [the produce of] the first five years with a deduction they disagree, such that one of them prohibits [it] — where is it permitted?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:5:3.english: Upon the completion of the years, etc. - For it does not appear like a loan, but rather like [one who is] purchasing the produce of these years from him for this money.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:6:1.hebrew: אין בעל חוב גובה הימנה - אם מת המלוה ונפלה לפני בניו, אין בעל חוב של אביהם גובה הימנה, דאין להם לאביהם בגופה של קרקע כלום, ומטלטלי בעלמא נינהו, ומטלטלי דיתמי לא משתעבדי לבעל חוב. דבשלמא בעודו קיים, גבי אפילו מגלימא דעל כתפיה, שהרי לו הלוה מעותיו ונשתעבד, והתורה אמרה: יבא שליח ב"ד ויכנס לביתו ויטול משכונו, דכתיב (דברים כ״ד:י״א) "והאיש אשר אתה נושה בו וגו'", ואמרינן לקמן (בבא מציעא דף קיג.): זה שליח ב"ד. אבל היכא דמית, בהדי יתמי מאי עבידתיה דתבע? הרי לא לוו ממנו. ואי ירתי קרקעות, משתעבדי נכסיה מחיים ומיחייב מדין ערב, דנכסייהו דבר איניש אינון ערבון ביה, דכי אוזפיה עלייהו סמך. אבל מטלטלי, אפילו דין ערב ליכא, דלאו עלייהו סמיך מלוה, הואיל ובידו להצניען ולאבדן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:6:1.english: A creditor cannot collect from it - If the lender died and [the mortgaged property] fell [as an inheritance] before his sons, their father's creditor cannot collect from it, for their father had nothing in the body of the land, and [the debt] is merely movable property, and movable property of orphans is not liened to a creditor. For it is understandable while he is alive [that the creditor] collects even from the cloak upon his shoulders, since he lent his money to him and he became obligated, and the Torah said [that] the agent of the court shall come and enter his house and take his pledge, as it is written (Deuteronomy 24:11): "And the man to whom you lend, etc.", and we say later (Bava Metzia 113a): This [refers to] the agent of the court. However, where he died, what business does he have with the orphans to claim [from them]? Behold, they did not borrow from him. And if they inherit land, his property was liened during his lifetime and is obligated by the law of a guarantor, for a person's property is his guarantor, since when he lent to him, he relied upon it. But [as for] movable property, there is not even the law of a guarantor, for a lender does not rely upon it, since it is in [the borrower's] power to conceal it and destroy it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:6:2.hebrew: ואין הבכור נוטל פי שנים - למאן דאמר בבבא בתרא (דף קכד:) דאין הבכור נוטל פי שנים במלוה, הא נמי, הואיל ואתרא דמסלקין, מלוה בעלמא הוא, דאין השדה לפניו אלא לשעבוד פירות, והוה ליה ראוי. ואין בכור נוטל בראוי לבא לפניהם לאחר מיתה לחלוק כבמוחזק ביד אביו, דכתיב (דברים כ״א:י״ז) בכל אשר ימצא לו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:6:2.english: And the firstborn does not take a double portion - According to the one who says in Bava Batra (124b) that a firstborn does not take a double portion in a loan, this too, since [it is] a place where they remove [the lender upon repayment], is merely a loan, for the field is not before him except as a lien on [its] produce, and [thus] it is [considered] prospective [property]. And a firstborn does not take [a double portion] in prospective [property] that is to come to them after [the father's] death to divide, as [he does] in that which is already in his father's possession, as it is written (Deuteronomy 21:17): "of all that is found with him."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:6:3.hebrew: ושביעית משמטתה - כשאר מלוה בשטר שנכסי לוה משועבדין להן, ושביעית משמטתן. דאין זה מלוה על משכון שאין שביעית משמטתו, דהתם במשכון של מטלטלין קיימינן, וטעמא משום דבעל חוב קונה משכון שבידו, דילפינן (לקמן בבא מציעא דף פב.) מולך תהיה צדקה, והוה ליה כגבוי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:6:3.english: And the Sabbatical [Year] cancels it - Like any other loan [recorded] in a document, to which the borrower's property is encumbered, and [yet] the Sabbatical [Year] cancels them. For this is not [like] a loan against collateral, which the Sabbatical [Year] does not cancel, since there we are dealing with collateral of movable property, and the reason is because a creditor acquires the collateral that is in his possession, as we derive (below, Bava Metzia 82a) from "And to you it shall be righteousness," and it is [considered] as [already] collected.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:7:1.hebrew: בעל חוב גובה ממנו - דמכר הוא אצלו, והיינו טעמא דכולהו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:7:1.english: A creditor collects from it - For it is [considered] a sale in his possession, and this is the reason for all of them.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:8:1.hebrew: אפי' מתמרי דאבודיא - כשגודרין תמרים, שוטחין מחצלות תחת הדקלין ונופלים התמרים עליהם. ואם בא ושילם לו מעותיו, מסלקו אף מן התמרים התלושין שעל המחצלות:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:8:1.english: Even from dates on the mats - When they harvest dates, they spread mats beneath the palm trees and the dates fall onto them. And if [the borrower] comes and pays him his money, he removes him even from the detached dates that are on the mats.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:8:2.english: And if he already lifted them in sisanei - That he placed them inside baskets when he took them from the mats.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:8:3.hebrew: קנה - אותם בהגבהה קודם שקיבל מעותיו, והרי הן שלו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:8:3.english: He acquired - them by lifting before he received his money, and behold, they are his.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:8:4.hebrew: ולמ"ד - בבבא בתרא (ד' פה:):
Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:8:4.english: And according to the one who says - In Bava Batra (85b).

Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:8:5.hebrew: כליו של לוקח קונה לו - ואפי' הוא ברשות של מוכר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:8:5.english: The buyer's vessel acquires [it] for him - And even when it is in the seller's domain.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:8:6.hebrew: אע"ג דלא אגבהינהו - לפי שקנו לו מחצלותיו, שהן כליו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:8:6.english: Even though he did not lift them - Because his mats, which are his vessels, acquired [them] for him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:9:1.hebrew: ואמר לא מסתלקנא - בשעת מתן מעות התנה: על מנת שלא תוכל לסלקני עד כך וכך שנים כו'. ועל מנת כן נתן מעותיה, וקרקע נקנה בכסף — בין דרך מקח, בין דרך שכירות, בין בכל הדרכים — כפי התנאי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:9:1.english: And he said: I will not be removed - At the time of giving [the] money, he stipulated: "On condition that you will not be able to remove me for such-and-such [a number of] years," etc. And on that condition he gave the money [for it], and land is acquired by money — whether by way of purchase, whether by way of rental, [or] in all ways — according to the stipulation.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:9:2.hebrew: צריך למיקנא מיניה - דאי לא קני מיניה, דיבורא בעלמא הוא ויכול לומר לא אשנה מן המנהג:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 67b:9:2.english: [Is it] necessary to perform an acquisition with him - For if he does not perform an acquisition with him, it is mere words, and he can say, "I will not deviate from the custom."

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 67b:10:1.hebrew: והלכתא צריך למקנא מיניה - אין לפרש משום דמלוה קאמר "מסתלקנא" והוי פטומי מילי, דלוה איבעי לאתנויי; דא"כ, אמאי צריך למיקנא? לימא דלוה יתנה! ונראה דאיירי לאחר שלוה הימנו סתם, דאפי' אם יתנה הלוה — צריך קנין שלא יחזור בו. דאי בתחילת הלואה, אע"ג דהוי אתרא דלא מסלקי — כיון שזה עמד וצווח, לא יכול לקנות אלא מה שהוא מקנה לו:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 67b:10:1.english: And the halakha is that it is necessary to perform an act of acquisition from him - One should not explain [that an act of acquisition is needed] because the lender said "I will be removed" and [therefore] it is mere words, since the borrower ought to have stipulated [it]; for if so, why is it necessary to perform an act of acquisition? Let [the Gemara] say [instead] that the borrower should stipulate! Rather, it appears that [the Gemara] is dealing with [a case] after he borrowed from him without stipulation, where even if the borrower stipulates, an act of acquisition is needed so that [the lender] cannot retract. For if [it were] at the beginning of the loan, even though it is a place where they do not remove [the lender], since this [borrower] stood up and protested, [the lender] can only acquire what [the borrower] transfers to him.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 67b:12:1.hebrew: רבינא אכל בנכייתא - תימה, דלעיל אמרינן דצורבא מרבנן אפי' בנכייתא לא ניכול; ועוד, דלעיל איפליגו בקיצותא רב אחא ורבינא, ואפי' מאן דשרי מודה בנכייתא דאסור, לכל הפחות לצורבא מרבנן! ואומר ר"ת, דרבינא לא היה רוצה ליטול השם ולעשות עצמו צורבא מרבנן. ועוד: נמצא מוגה בספרו של רבינו תם "רפרם" במקום "רבינא" בפלוגתא דקיצותא. וי"מ, דהך נכייתא דרבינא היינו קיצותא, דאיכא דאמר לעיל: "חמש שנים אכליה בנכייתא, מכאן ואילך שיימינן לכולהו פירות"; דהא פליגי רב אחא ורבינא, וקיימא לן דרבינא לקולא. ונראה שגם ר"ח סובר כן, שפסק דקיי"ל כרב אשי דלא אכיל בנכייתא, ולא שרי לצורבא מרבנן אלא כמשכנתא דסורא; אם כן ר"ל, דנכייתא דהכא הוה קיצותא, מדלא שרי אלא כמשכנתא דסורא:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 67b:12:1.english: Ravina would consume [produce] with a deduction - This is perplexing, for above we say that a Torah scholar should not consume [produce] even with a deduction; and furthermore, above Rav Acha and Ravina disagreed regarding [a mortgage with] a fixed arrangement (kitzuta), and even the one who permits [kitzuta] concedes regarding [ordinary] deduction that it is forbidden, at the very least for a Torah scholar! And Rabbeinu Tam says that Ravina did not want to take the title [upon himself] and make himself [out to be] a Torah scholar. Furthermore, in Rabbeinu Tam's book it was found emended [to read] "Rafram" instead of "Ravina" in the dispute over kitzuta. And some explain that this "deduction" of Ravina [here] is [actually] kitzuta, as there is [an opinion] that says above: "For five years he consumes it with a deduction; from then on, we appraise all the produce" — for Rav Acha and Ravina disagree [about this], and the law is established in accordance with Ravina, [who rules] leniently. And it appears that Rabbeinu Chananel also holds this way, for he ruled that the law is established in accordance with Rav Ashi, who would not consume [produce] with a deduction, and he only permits [it] for a Torah scholar like a Sura mortgage; if so, he means to say that the deduction [mentioned] here was kitzuta, since he only permits [it] like a Sura mortgage.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 67b:5:1.hebrew: במישלם שניא אילין תיפוק ארעא דא בלא כסף - תימה: מה בין זה לנכיית'? דע"כ יכול לסלקו, דאם לא היה יכול לסלקו, אם כן בלא נכייתא נמי שרי, כדמשמע לעיל דקאמר: "באתרא דמסלקי לא ניכול אלא בנכייתא", משמע אבל באתרא דלא מסלקי, אכלי אפילו בלא נכייתא. וזה דוחק לומר דבנכייתא אין דרך לנכות אלא דבר מועט, אבל במשכנתא דסורא רגילים היו לשום כדי שויו — דמשמע דמשום דכתיבי הכי שרי. וי"ל דמאחר שמפרש כן, לא מיחזי כהלואה, אלא כלוקח ממנו פירות של השנים הללו באותן דמים. אבל כשאינו כותב לו כך, אלא מנכה כל שנה ושנה בפני עצמה, נראה כאילו מוזיל גביה פירות אותה שנה בשכר מותר המלוה, כדתנן (לעיל בבא מציעא ד' סד:): "לא ישכור הימנו בפחות". ואפילו אם נאמר שלא יוכל לייקר לו פירות של שנה אחרת, דמסתמא אין באין לעשות תנאי חדש בכל שנה, מ"מ הואיל ולא קצבו סכום כל השנים לפרש בשטר "במישלם שניא אילין תיפוק", מיחזי כהלואה:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 67b:5:1.english: "Upon the completion of these years, this land shall leave [his possession] without money" - It is astonishing: What is the difference between this and [a mortgage with] a deduction [from the loan]? For perforce [the borrower] can pay him off [and redeem the land early], since if he could not pay him off, then even without a deduction it would also be permitted, as is implied above where [the Gemara] says: "In a place where they can pay [the lender] off, he may not consume [the produce] except with a deduction," which implies that in a place where they cannot pay [him] off, they may consume [the produce] even without a deduction. And it is forced to say that with a deduction it is customary to deduct only a small amount, whereas with a Sura mortgage they were accustomed to appraise [the produce] according to its full value — for it is implied [in the Gemara] that it is because they write this [formula] that it is permitted. And one can answer that since he specifies [it] in this way, it does not look like a loan, but rather as though he is buying from him the produce of these years for that sum of money. However, when he does not write thus for him, but rather deducts each and every year on its own, it looks as though [the borrower] is discounting for him the produce of that year as a reward for [waiting for] the remainder of the loan, as we learned in the Mishnah (above, Bava Metzia 64b): "He may not rent [a field] from him for less [than its value]." And even if we say that [the borrower] cannot raise the price of the produce of another year for him, since presumably they do not come to make a new stipulation each year, nevertheless, since they did not fix a [total] sum for all the years to specify in the document, "Upon the completion of these years, [this land] shall leave," it looks like a loan.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 67b:6:1.hebrew: האי משכנתא באתרא דמסלקי, אין ב"ח גובה הימנה - דהוי כמטלטלי דיתמי דלא משתעבדי לבעל חוב. ולא דמי ליתומים שגבו קרקע בחובת אביהן, דב"ח חוזר וגובה אותה מהן אע"ג דשומא הדרא לעולם — דלא הדרא אלא משום "ועשית הישר והטוב", ומרישא הוא דקא זבין לה, כדאמרינן בפ"ק (לעיל בבא מציעא ד' טז:); ולהכי נמי אוכלין הפירות בלא נכייתא:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 67b:6:1.english: This mortgage, in a place where they remove [the lender], a creditor cannot collect from it - for it is like movable property of orphans, which is not mortgaged to a creditor. And it is not similar to orphans who collected land for their father's debt, where a creditor [of the father] can in turn collect it from them even though an appraised property [seized for debt] can always be redeemed — because it only returns on account of "And you shall do what is right and good," and it is as if [the debtor] is buying it anew [when redeeming it], as we say in the first chapter (above, Bava Metzia 16b); and for this reason too, they consume the produce without deduction.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 67b:6:2.hebrew: ושביעית משמטתה - לא דמי למלוה על המשכון דאינה משמטתה, דשאני מטלטלין דתפיס להו וקנה להו שלא בשעת הלואתו כר' יצחק (לקמן בבא מציעא ד' פב.), ולהכי גם בשעת הלואה חשוב של אחיך בידך, אבל קרקע לא:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 67b:6:2.english: And the Sabbatical [Year] cancels it - This is not similar to one who lends on a pledge, where [the Sabbatical Year] does not cancel [the debt], for movable property is different, since he holds it and acquires it [even] not at the time of his loan, in accordance with Rabbi Yitzchak (below, Bava Metzia 82a), and therefore even [when taken] at the time of the loan, it is considered [as property] of your brother [that is already] in your hand, whereas land is not:
